absolute_value_ceiling.not_affected: The sealed 10,000-case regression. Its corpus is in region format (3,816 regions for 2,000 clusters), so its 25.38% is measured against matching granularity.
absolute_value_ceiling.statement: The development source package supplies cluster-level spans while the development gold expects sentence-level sub-spans. The product cites the whole cluster it was given, so citation and atomic-claim scores are exactly 0.0 on all 235 correctly answered cases while answer span recall averages 0.9234 with 217 of 235 perfect.
absolute_value_ceiling.what_is_not_valid: The absolute figures. 15.80% and 12.60% are held down by the granularity mismatch and must not be read as the product's grounding quality.
absolute_value_ceiling.what_remains_valid: The ranking between arms. Every arm saw the identical corpus and gold, so the granularity ceiling applies equally and the comparison still answers which gate is better on this corpus.

arms_correction.what_changed: The incumbent arm identity only; no threshold or decision rule moved.
arms_correction.what_was_wrong: The incumbent was first read from deploy/local-r1.env.example, a template, rather than .env.local-r1, the deployment env.
